verdict.rationale: Jev is a typed-decision API that returns probabilities and confidence. Its docs describe routing and guardrail patterns, but in each one the user's own code applies the thresholds and takes the action. Nothing shows a product-native way to define event-triggered rules or automations, so these patterns are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
